svg.title: USB3-PIPE: USB3 SuperSpeed for FPGAs, no external chip
svg.desc: USB3-PIPE on the Acorn CLE-215+: the USB3 host connects through an SFP2USB adapter to an Artix7 GTP transceiver (reference clock from the 200 MHz oscillator on GTGREFCLK). The USB3 PHY (usb3_pipe: SerDes datapath, PIPE, LTSSM) provides link-trained 32-bit symbols to the USB3 Device Core (usb3_core: Link and Protocol layers, Control endpoint, Bulk/Isochronous endpoints), which serves the device classes: vendor Bulk, UVC camera, CDC-ACM (LiteX BIOS console on a VexRiscv) and Mass Storage (block RAM or DDR3 through LiteDRAM). Standard Linux drivers on the host.

g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
g.text: LiteX Acorn Baseboard Mini · SQRL Acorn CLE-215+
PHY (+ Device Core) for any Verilog/VHDL design
USB3-PIPE: USB3 SuperSpeed for FPGAs, no external chip
FPGA transceiver → USB3 PHY → USB3 Device Core → standard host drivers: camera, serial console, mass storage
Bulk IN 446 MB/s · OUT 449 MB/s · Artix7 GTP / Kintex7 GTX / Ultrascale+ GTY · Migen/LiteX
